# Leslie Moore

[Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian)

- **Age:** 28  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015)</sub>

- **Family:** [Dick](../character/dick.md) (spouse), [Kenneth](../character/kenneth.md) (sibling), West (relative)

## Appearance

Leslie is a woman with a beautiful face and striking sea-blue eyes that can fill with soft laughter and allurement. She possesses long, shining hair that gleams like molten gold in the firelight and falls around her in a fountain to her feet. Though slender, her hands are brown and work-hardened.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P17](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P14](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P16](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P38](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0038), +1 more_

## Personality

Leslie Moore possesses a glowing, pent-up personality characterized by resoluteness and a strong sense of duty, though she is not particularly socially inclined. Highly skilled in dancing, she harbors a deep desire for motherhood, fiercely stating she would give her life to experience it. She plans to pursue nursing in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) to make the most of her life, and she is actively preparing to marry Owen at [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P17](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P27](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000), +2 more_

## History

Leslie Moore suffered immense hardship in her youth, finding her father after he committed suicide at age fourteen. She managed to complete two years of study in one at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) using money inherited from her grandmother, later taking a position as a schoolteacher at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) school. At age sixteen, however, she was coerced into marrying [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) to prevent Abner Moore from foreclosing on her mother's farm, though her mother died of pneumonia a year later. Living in [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), Leslie met [Anne](../character/anne.md) [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) on the harbor shore, and after initial distance caused by her painful history, she slowly warmed to [Anne](../character/anne.md) through shared visits, eventually confessing her past envy and forging a deep friendship. She took in writer [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) as a summer boarder, and during his stay, she secretly fell in love with him, tearfully confessing her unrequited feelings to [Anne](../character/anne.md) when he departed. When Dr. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposed a brain operation that might restore the memory of the brain-injured man believed to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), Leslie borrowed money from Captain Jim to finance the trip to a [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) hospital. The operation revealed the man was actually Dick's cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), leaving Leslie free from her bond and overjoyed to discover the real [Dick](../character/dick.md) had died years prior. After returning home, Leslie reconciled her feelings during a stay at Anne's house and accepted [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) when he returned to confess his love, securing their future together shortly before Captain Jim passed away and Owen purchased [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Gilbert's home for their summer vacations.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P0](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P2](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P3](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P6](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P7](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P9](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0009), +515 more_

## Quotes

> "I knew who YOU were, although I had never seen either of you before. I had heard of the new doctor and his bride who were coming to live in Miss Russell’s little house. I—I hated you that very moment, Anne."
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P19](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0019)

> "She is mistaken—or prejudiced. I think my figure IS better—mother was slight and bent by hard work—but she had the face of an angel. I used just to look up at her in worship. We all worshipped her,—father and Kenneth and I."
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P37](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0037)

> “Kenneth was my brother,” went on Leslie. “Oh, I can’t tell you how I loved him. And he was cruelly killed. Do you know how?”
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P39](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0039)

> "Anne, I saw his little face as the wheel went over him. He fell on his back. Anne—Anne—I can see it now. I shall always see it. Anne, all I ask of heaven is that that recollection shall be blotted out of my memory. O my God!"
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P41](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0041)

> "I can’t tell you—don’t ask me. I wouldn’t mind your knowing—I wish you did know—but I can’t tell you—I can’t tell anyone. I’ve been such a fool, Anne—and oh, it hurts so terribly to be a fool. There’s nothing so painful in the world."
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P11](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--leslie-moore.md)

Leslie met [Anne](../character/anne.md) along the shore of [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), where they bonded over the local landscape and agreed to visit one another. Though Leslie initially maintained a distant and occasionally resentment-filled composure due to her own tragic past, their shared walks, fireside gatherings, and Leslie's confession of her bitter feelings ultimately forged a deep and warm friendship. [Anne](../character/anne.md) provides Leslie with comfort, understanding, and a supportive refuge during her darkest emotional struggles.

- Comrade of — rambles and fireside communings  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002)</sub>
- Friend of — neighbors and tramping companions  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P30](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), +8 more</sub>

### [Carlo](../character/carlo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carlo--leslie-moore.md)

[Carlo](../character/carlo.md) was Leslie's faithful old dog and a source of personal comfort. Following his death, Leslie mourned him deeply as she navigated her emotional turmoil.

### [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--leslie-moore.md)

Miss Cornelia acts as a caring neighbor and friend to Leslie, actively advocating for her well-being in the community. She takes an affectionate interest in Leslie's life, from encouraging others to befriend her despite her cold exterior to helping arrange a summer boarder for her home.

- Friend of — caring friend and neighbor  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P29](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0029), +1 more</sub>

### [Dick](../character/dick.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--leslie-moore.md)

Leslie lived for years in a painful marriage to the man she believed to be her husband, [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), whose tragic condition weighed heavily on her life. Their relationship was defined by her dutiful caretaking and intense private grief, along with deep emotional envy toward those with happier lives. This dynamic ended when an operation revealed that the man was actually Dick's lookalike cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), and that the real [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) had died years earlier.

- Spouse of — married  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), +9 more</sub>

[First Mate](../character/first-mate.md) is the beloved pet cat residing at Captain Jim's lighthouse, where Leslie frequently spends social evenings with her friends. She interacts with the cat as part of the welcoming household atmosphere during these shore gatherings.

### [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george-moore--leslie-moore.md)

Leslie spent years caring for [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) under the mistaken belief that he was her husband, [Dick](../character/dick.md). After taking him to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for a medical procedure, his memory returned, revealing his true identity as Dick's cousin; his sister subsequently took him home to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) while Leslie maintained contact with him through letters.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--leslie-moore.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is a reliable friend who frequently includes Leslie in autumn walks, holiday gatherings, and visits to the local lighthouse alongside his wife, [Anne](../character/anne.md).
